'''January 2001 Parker tournament (13 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, CO on 13 January 2001. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1691">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-30-parker-co-01-13-01-the-new-era-beginsd1691/ parker-co-01-13-01-the-new-era-begins], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 30 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-30-parker-co-01-13-01-the-new-era-beginsd1691/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 13 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Parker, CO
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 23
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
